info.description: Complete Spotify Clone Backend API Collection with full endpoint coverage, positive & negative test cases, auto token/id chaining, rate-limit aware auth, artist verification flow, admin moderation, payments/Stripe, and webhook reference. Generated to match current backend routes (auth, users, music, playlists, queue, likes, payment, admin, webhook).

request.description: Note: 'role' input on register is ignored/rejected by design per NO-ROLE-INPUT security fix in current backend. Verify server behavior matches intended access control (artist role should require separate approval flow, not self-declared at registration).

Webhook route is mounted separately (raw body, NOT under /api). Test with an invalid/missing 'stripe-signature' header — expect 400 'Invalid Stripe Signature'. Use Stripe CLI (stripe trigger checkout.session.completed) for real end-to-end tests with a valid signature; Postman cannot compute a valid Stripe signature without the webhook secret.
